state.background: Phase 6 batch B09 transfers one Plan45 stable scenario: p45-b-real-consumption-174-page-tsx-e2e-real-consumption-chart-with-actual-browser (#174). The source contract is exact: use the shared fixture's __MOUNT_ALL__ setup, navigate to production `/` in Chromium, wait for networkidle, scroll #section-consumption-real into view, require the section visible within 15 seconds, then require its summary visible. The source test title mentions style/SVG, but its actual predicates are only section visibility and summary visibility; Browser Mode mirrors those predicates and asserts no style or SVG property. The source spec is now deleted because all seven of its cases were mapped to already accepted B07 (#21/#60/#82), B08 (#99/#128/#156), and B09 (#174) Browser Mode coverage; shared fixtures.ts remains unchanged. Independent review and post-cutover source audit passed. Focused Browser Mode passed 1/1; residual Playwright completed build/type-check and passed 14 with 18 skipped. Starting from B08 M=111, B09 advances M to 112; 22 of 33 eligible Phase 6 scenarios are accepted, 11 remain Playwright-owned, and Phase 6 remains in progress.
acceptanceCriteria: The B09 stable ID preserves the exact source predicates in a permanent fail-on-contract Browser Mode test: production `/` in Chromium, source fixture mount setup, networkidle, scroll into view, section visibility within 15 seconds, and summary visibility.
The implementation does not add claims or checks for styling or SVG merely because the source test title mentions them; the actual source contract is section and summary visibility only.
The E2E source spec was removed only after all seven cases had accepted Browser Mode replacements across B07, B08, and B09; shared fixtures.ts remains unchanged.
The focused production Browser Mode suite and post-cutover residual E2E suite pass, and independent review/source-boundary audit support the cutover.
The cumulative ledger advances from A=123/E=123/M=111 to A=123/E=123/M=112, with 22 accepted and 11 pending out of 33.
verification: Focused run `pnpm run test:browser:phase6-b09:built` passed one file / one test. Durable log: results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b09-browser-mode-validation-2026-09-27.log.

After source cutover, residual `pnpm test:e2e:fresh` completed build/type-check and passed 14 tests with 18 skipped and zero failures. Durable log: results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b09-residual-e2e-validation-2026-09-27.log.
Independent review and post-cutover source-boundary audit passed; shared fixtures.ts was preserved.
